description: Conformance corpus for firing one phase of a phased hook. Every runtime loads `mod`, runs `setup` once, then fires each case's `hook` at `phase` with `data` as the single payload value (absent when the case has no `data` key), and the results must equal `expected`, in order. Only the handlers registered for that phase run. A phase the hook does not declare, a hook with no phases, and an unknown hook all run nothing and return an empty list. Hook fills are unphased and never run on a phased fire. A `phase` of "" is no phase: the fire runs exactly what an unphased fire runs, hook fills included.
notes: The JavaScript runtimes fire with `fireHook(hook, { phase, data })`, the Rust runtime with `fire_hook_phase(hook, phase, data)` where `data` is an `Option`, and the C# runtime with `FireHook(hook, new FireHookOptions { Phase, Data })`.

A plain object `data` spreads to its values in key order; any other `data` is the one argument; no `data` passes no arguments. Keys here are written in code-point order so a host that sorts object keys spreads them the same way.
`mod` fills the `ping` event slot with an export, loaded from `mod.source` as its entry script `mod.js`, before `setup` runs.
What an unphased fire does with phased handlers is not pinned here, so the empty phase is pinned only on hooks without phases.
setup: hooks.save.pre(function (a, b) { return 'pre1:' + a + ',' + b; }); hooks.save.post(function (a, b) { return 'post:' + a + ',' + b; }); hooks.save.pre(function () { return 'pre2:' + arguments.length; }); hooks.tick(function (x) { return 'tick:' + x; }); hooks.ping(function (x) { return 'ping:' + x; });

cases.name: only the named phase's handlers run, in registration order
the other phase runs its own handler
a non-object payload is the one argument
an array payload is the one argument, not spread
a hook without phases runs nothing on a phased fire
the empty phase is no phase: an unphased hook's handlers run
the empty phase runs an event slot's handlers, then its fills
the empty phase spreads an object payload to handlers and fills alike
the empty phase with no payload passes no arguments
a named phase still never runs fills
